turns.text: 5:44 am update, typing one-handed sorry. i just accepted the infant spot at Little Egrets on Pell Road, starts jan 5, $1,850 a month. need a plan around it. hana's back at work so i'm the primary daytime parent right now, weekdays are all me (my mom helps some). can you give me a plan for what to do between now and jan 5, in table form please

Congrats on getting the spot, that's a big one to check off. Here's a plan in table form. I don't know your exact dates, so I used rough timing and left blanks where you'll fill in details.

| When | Task | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| This week | Confirm enrollment paperwork and deposit | Ask for the full document list and any deposit or registration fee |
| This week | Ask about immunization and health forms | Get the pediatrician appointment on the calendar if a form needs signing |
| By end of Nov | Tour or orientation visit | Ask about drop-off routine, bottle and formula handling, and sleep policy |
| Early Dec | Label and pack supplies | Bottles, spare clothes, pacifiers, blankets as allowed, all labeled |
| Mid Dec | Start practicing the daycare nap and feed rhythm at home | Shift toward their schedule gradually |
| Late Dec | Trial run of the morning routine and commute | Time it door to door |
| Jan 2-4 | Final check | Bag packed, forms in, emergency contacts submitted |
| Jan 5 | First day | Consider a short first day if they allow it |

Want me to add a budget section next?

yes. $1,850 a month, how does that fit my target? i'm trying to keep monthly spending under $5,200 while on leave pay. also brenda's monday email lands at 8:15 and it's monday, so i want the daycare news ready before i reply about my return

Sure. I only have your target and the tuition, so here's the math and a place for the rest:

| Item | Monthly |
|---|---|
| Spending target | $5,200 |
| Daycare tuition | $1,850 |
| Left for everything else | $3,350 |

So daycare would be about 36% of your target. To see if $3,350 covers everything else, add up your fixed costs (rent, utilities, car, groceries, and so on) and see what's left. Also plan for extras: a registration or deposit fee, supplies, and maybe a gap if tuition is due before your pay changes.

For the 8:15 email, a short draft you can adjust:

"Hi [name], thanks for checking in. I wanted to share that we've secured an infant daycare spot starting Jan 5. I'm confirming my return plan around that and will follow up with [date/details] shortly. Thanks, [your name]"

Only send what you're comfortable committing to. Want to tweak the tone?
